jobs.title: Home Chef
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Home Chef for a household in Wuye, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role with accommodation and weekly days off.
Responsibilities: Plan and cook daily meals for the household to a consistently high standard. Prepare dishes to suit the household's tastes and any dietary needs. Plan weekly menus and portions, and suggest new dishes. Keep the kitchen clean and follow food safety and hygiene standards. Monitor kitchen stock, buy or request groceries and keep waste low.
Requirements: Certificate from a culinary school At least 2 years' experience as a chef Good communication skills Presentable and able to work with little to no supervision Able to work in Wuye, Abuja and resume immediately CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Accommodation. Weekly days off.

jobs.title: Paid Internship Programme
jobs.description:
We are hiring corps members and graduates for a paid internship programme with our client in the real estate sector in Lagos (Ibeju-Lekki) and Abuja. No experience needed. Selected candidates will be trained for 6 to 12 months.
Responsibilities: Join a paid internship programme with our client in the real estate sector in Lagos (Ibeju Lekki) and Abuja. Be trained for 6 to 12 months, learning how the business works from the people who run it. Support the team with day-to-day tasks as you learn. No experience is needed: selected candidates are trained from the start.
Requirements: A serving corps member or a graduate of a Nigerian university No previous experience needed Good communication skills and a willingness to learn Able to work full time in Lagos (Ibeju Lekki) and/or Abuja CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Paid internship. 6 to 12 months of training.

jobs.title: Sports Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Sports Product Manager in Wuye, Abuja. This is a hybrid role, and the salary of ₦250,000 per month is negotiable.
Responsibilities: Plan, source and manage the range of sports products sold online. Create and update product listings with clear descriptions, photos and prices. Track stock, sales and customer feedback, and recommend what to stock next. Work with suppliers, the sales team and customer service to keep the store running smoothly.
Requirements: Experience in e-commerce and product management A love for sports or sporting activities, with good knowledge of sports products Good communication, organisation and analytical skills Able to work a hybrid schedule in Wuye, Abuja CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Other statutory benefits.

jobs.title: Accountant
jobs.description:
We are hiring an Accountant in Gwarimpa, Abuja. This is a full-time, onsite role for an experienced accountant with 5 to 8 years' experience.
Responsibilities: Keep accurate books of account and prepare regular ledger and bank reconciliations. Prepare and file tax and other statutory returns on time. Prepare monthly financial reports for management.
Requirements: B.Sc or HND in Accounting, Finance or a related field ICAN or ACCA (certified or part-qualified) 5 to 8 Years' Experience in Accounting Knowledge of Nigerian tax rules CV Required (PDF)
Benefits: Professional development support. Performance bonus. Other statutory benefits.
